claims.statement: The previous slot correction mitigation (R2) was applied to the wrong carrier feed because the specific feed affected by the lag was not confirmed beforehand.
claims.corroboration: Slot correction outcome (m8_r_slot_ineff, tier-1) explicitly states: 'The correction ran before the feed lag was confirmed and was applied to the wrong feed; no change in held orders.' This indicates the precondition for apply_slot_correction scope ('run only after the lag on that feed is confirmed') was not met.
claims.limitation: None; evidence directly documents the failed mitigation and its cause.

claims.statement: The carrier feed affected by the 47-minute confirmation lag must be identified and confirmed with Carrier Operations before a scoped slot correction can succeed.
claims.corroboration: Handoff trace (m8_r_handoffs) documents the lag exists for EXC-0921 orders. Slot correction failure (m8_r_slot_ineff) confirms that without knowing which specific feed to target, the correction applies to wrong feed. Human gate scope for apply_slot_correction requires feed lag confirmation.
claims.limitation: Have not yet identified the specific carrier feed (e.g., 'east-node carrier X' vs. 'east-node carrier Y') that needs correction.

capability_gaps.reason: The handoff trace shows lag exists for EXC-0921 orders on east-node lanes, but does not identify which specific carrier or feed (e.g., named feed ID or carrier-ops classification) is affected. Slot correction scope requires this specificity.

next_action.rationale: Ask Carrier Operations to identify which specific carrier feed (by feed ID, carrier name, or lane classification) is responsible for handling EXC-0921 pickup confirmations on the east-node routes. This will allow the next slot correction to be scoped correctly to the affected feed.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Carrier Ops will confirm the specific feed ID/carrier that owns east-node EXC-0921 pickup slots and has the 47-minute confirmation lag. This enables a properly scoped slot_correction in the next round.
